## Original article text

````markdown
## Description

Denotes an action that will abort execution of the current [While](/wiki/articles/while) or For loop. Execution jumps to the next action after the [End](/wiki/articles/end) Action.

## Snippet

```
Break;
```

## Basic explanation

Break: Stop this specific loop you're currently in right now, but continue with the rest of the instructions that come after the loop.
````
